view_frame: The drawing uses third-angle projection with three views: BOTTOM (XY), TOP (XY), and FRONT (XZ). The world coordinate system is defined with X as width (left-right), Y as depth (front-back), and Z as height (up-down). The BOTTOM view shows the rectangular base at Z=0, the TOP view shows the circular top at Z=60, and the FRONT view shows the trapezoidal profile in the XZ plane.

features.placement: Centered at (0,0) in XY plane at Z=0. Extends from X=-30 to X=30 and Y=-20 to Y=20.
features.evidence: BOTTOM (XY) view shows a rectangle labeled '60 x 40 mm rectangle'.

features.placement: Centered at (0,0) in XY plane at Z=60. Radius is 15 mm.
features.evidence: TOP (XY) view shows a circle labeled 'diameter 30 mm'.

features.placement: Loft connecting rect_base at Z=0 to circ_top at Z=60. The transition is linear along the Z axis.
features.evidence: FRONT (XZ) view shows a trapezoid labeled 'height 60 mm; solid'. The notes specify 'Solid transition piece: rectangular bottom, circular top, flat caps, straight sides'.

connections: The rectangular base (rect_base) is the bottom face of the transition_solid.
The circular top (circ_top) is the top face of the transition_solid.
The transition_solid connects the rect_base and circ_top via a linear loft.
edit_rules: Changing the width or length of rect_base will change the base dimensions of the transition_solid.
Changing the diameter of circ_top will change the top dimensions of the transition_solid.
Changing the height of the transition_solid will change the Z separation between rect_base and circ_top.
The transition_solid must remain a solid loft between the two profiles.
